summary.en: Local memory hub for multi-channel DSH characters: per-source memory with snapshots and restore, inbox/outbox with per-client targets, offline merge, and optional payment intents.
summary.zh: 多端 DSH 角色的本机记忆中枢：按来源隔离记忆、自动快照与恢复，支持分端收件箱/发件箱、离线来源并回，以及可选的支付意图配置。

zh: 按 character（角色）和 source（来源，如 qq / pc / mobile）分开存记忆
每个来源独立，删除一个来源不影响其他来源
每次写入前自动快照，默认保留 100 份
支持删除指定来源的一条记录，或恢复到最近/指定快照
Inbox 收件箱，支持 target 分端投递，离线时先存本地、上线再取
Outbox 发件箱，把消息投递到安装者自己配置的本机通道
/cross 一次写入并投递到指定通道
/memory/flush 把离线来源并回正常来源，自动去重并清空离线来源
可选 payment 配置：校验金额档位、生成本地支付意图和带金额的支付地址，不处理支付凭证
默认只监听 127.0.0.1，数据落在本机 ~/.dsh/memory-hub.json
模型工具：安装者自己的模型可调用 memory_hub_* 自动读写本机记忆
安装即用：默认注册 memory_hub_* 工具，停用后不启动服务、不注册工具、不影响模型
端数不设限：角色/来源支持任意 Unicode，客户端数量与容量由安装者本机决定，上限可设 0 表示不限
隐私默认：无遥测、不主动联网、不收集安装者或用户数据，任何收集需显式同意
en: Per-character and per-source memory (qq / pc / mobile)
Sources are isolated: deleting one never touches another
Automatic snapshot before each write, 100 kept by default
Delete one record or restore the latest/named snapshot
Inbox with per-client targets: offline messages wait locally
Outbox delivery to installer-configured local channels
/cross writes an inbox item and delivers it in one call
/memory/flush merges an offline source back with dedupe
Optional payment config: amount presets, local payment intents, checkout URL; no payment credentials
Listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; data stays in ~/.dsh/memory-hub.json
Model tools: the installer's own model can call memory_hub_* to read/write local memory
Ready after install: memory_hub_* tools register by default; disabling stops the server and tools without affecting the model
No fixed endpoint cap: Unicode character/source names, any number of local clients, configurable limits with 0 meaning unlimited
Privacy by default: no telemetry, no outbound collection, explicit consent required for any collection
